prompts.caneca: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single photorealistic luxury catalog product photograph for the NeuralMind brand guide. Reference image is ONLY the official approved logo artwork; reproduce its lettering precisely in white on the product. Subject: one premium deep purple ceramic coffee mug, white warm porcelain interior, graceful handle on the right, three quarter frontal view. Crisp white silkscreen NEURALMIND wordmark centered horizontally on the broad front. Entire mug visible. Scene: warm off-white studio seamless background and matte tabletop, soft natural contact shadow. Palette: product deep aubergine purple #290241, logo warm white #fffffc. Lighting: large softbox from upper left, gentle fill, restrained highlights, realistic material microtexture. Composition: landscape 4:3 photograph, centered product, generous 12 percent clear margins, cohesive art direction across a catalog of branded merchandise. Camera: high end commercial photography, 85mm lens look, entire product sharp. Exact text: "NEURALMIND", uppercase, wide tracking and heavy serif letterforms EXACTLY as reference 08D (Cormorant Garamond bold reinforced serif). No .AI suffix. Logo must be printed on the actual surface with correct perspective and lighting; preserve letter shapes and spelling. Avoid: vector art, illustration, cartoon, flat graphic silhouettes, plastic-looking CGI, collage, extra objects, extra logos, text captions, watermark, slogan. Deliver ONE standalone product image.
